about: [O2] The hijack of a car with a man with a jaw at the wheel, idle at his door (brief O2 §3, §5): E at his door, I am in his seat, and then nothing - he is back for his car (warned: He’s coming back.), has me out, and the fight (the base Brawl) is lost standing there: he gets in and drives off. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o2_fighter_idle.json

steps.check: D.fight === true && D.warned && D.warned.warn === 'He’s coming back.' && D.fightAt - D.warned.at > 1000
steps.label: idle at his door: warned a second and more before he has me out of the seat, the fight

steps.expect: !G.city.inCar && G.wheels.traffic.cars.some((c) => c.kind === 'saloon' && c.driver.kind === 'fighter' && Math.hypot(c.v.pos.x - G.eye.x, c.v.pos.z - G.eye.z) < 40) && !G.brawl.active && N.controller.mode === 'walk'
steps.label: lost: he has his car back and drives off; I am on the pavement, the controls mine
